mapper.select: SELECT source_id,ai_summary,ai_category, ai_severity,ai_confidence,ai_explanation,CAST(evidence_codes AS CHAR) evidence_codes,ai_processed_at FROM t_feedback_ai WHERE review_status='PENDING' AND ai_processed_at IS NOT NULL AND source_id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_feedback_ai SET review_status=#{status},reviewed_by=#{reviewer},reviewed_at=NOW(3), review_comment=#{comment} WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND review_status='PENDING'
